verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships AI features (Comply AI), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Secureframe's own MCP server, which exposes its data to external agents. That is the server role and does not show Secureframe acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools. Its custom integrations and API are data-ingestion mechanisms, not MCP tool use, so there is no evidence it delivers this story.
